name: HaloPad
notes: HaloPad owns padmint.json; the iOS target runs scripts/builder/build.sh with the player's HaloCESetup.exe (the 1.10 update and an optional product-key.txt beside it). Complete PadMint build recorded 4 Oct; device acceptance of a builder-made app is still open. The game package (Halo-CE.halopad.zip) is written next to the IPA in the backend folder.
